comment: L1 baseline for the permission rules (design section 5). Patterns use the wildcard syntax of @gotgenes/pi-permission-system: * matches any characters including /, ? one character, a trailing ' *' also matches the bare command. {agentDir} is replaced by the Pi agent dir. The codemode tool is allowlisted: every call its script makes runs through the tool_call hooks on its own (overlay, guards, permission system; tests/replay/test_replay_codemode.py), so the script itself needs no approval. Layers add to these lists through safety.permissions in foreman.json; nothing below can be removed by a layer.

externalDirectory.comment: Owned paths outside the workspace (docs/permissions.md, Owned paths). allow: bare external_directory keys (read and write); read: external_directory_read keys; ask: keys appended last so they win. Tokens: {agentDir}, {scratchRoot} (<realpath tmpdir>/pi-foreman-scratch, the children's scratch root), {tmpRoot} (the realpath of the OS temp dir; the pi-subagents run root lives below it), {npmRoot} (npm root -g, resolved when the file is rendered; the pattern is dropped when it does not resolve). The patterns are per user, not per session: the overlay keeps children out of the main-only ones. probe: toolchain bin dirs and the npx cache, rendered as external_directory_read keys (each dir and dir/*; a leading ~ is the home dir, %APPDATA% only on Windows, an entry that does not resolve is dropped); the overlay narrows them to a plain ls/stat/which shell line and the ls tool, anything else naming them asks.

protect.comment: Write protection, enforced by the adapter overlay only (the permission system's path rules cannot tell a read from a write). Each pattern is checked against the path of write/edit, the destination (and a moved source) of foreman_move/foreman_copy and, except writeAsk, every path word of a shell command. deny: every session. ask: the foreman is asked, children are denied. childDeny: children only. removeAsk: like ask, but only for a remove or rename of the path itself (rm, rmdir, trash, mv, Remove-Item and the like, inline code of python -c/node -e, the moved source of foreman_move); reading or listing it stays allowed. writeAsk: like ask, but shell words are checked in children only (the foreman's shell may read and run the package; the opened session re-reads its handoff dir's `parent` file, the opener's intercom id that the close check trusts, before every message). A `*` also matches `/`. {cwd} is the session cwd, {agentDirParent} the agent dir's parent folder (~/.pi by default), {pkgRoot} the pi-foreman package root. {xdgConfigHome} is $XDG_CONFIG_HOME (patterns using it are dropped when it is unset). CLAUDE.md is not protected: claude-bridge excludes CLAUDE.md and .claude/rules from its turns (claudeMdExcludes), so it is ordinary project text.
